subject: Iraola goes viral after visiting a grassroots kids' match in Maghull
title: Iraola's grassroots moment

lines.vo: One photo, two kids, one million views. Guess the manager.
Andoni Iraola watched a junior Maghull match, reportedly to see a relative. He posed with the children, and the internet did the rest.
Maghull manager Joe Burns says he spent a long time with the kids.
Earlier this year, still at Bournemouth, he ran the line at a local match. Most managers argue with the officials. Iraola became one.
Fans call him a down-to-earth fella. A million views say they are right. Best title of the season, and no trophy needed.

inserts.story: Setup: chibi parents cheer from the touchline. Gag: the coach answers only in a silent cloud of speech bubbles. Twist: one giant bubble bursts and reads ONE MILLION VIEWS.
Setup: the anime coach takes a flag as an assistant referee. Gag: his arms spin like a windmill and both flags fly into the sky. Twist: he calls offside on his own shadow, and the shadow argues back.
